hints.title: Partition Across Non-Crossing Chord
hints.text: Fix person 1 shaking hands with person i; to avoid crossings, i must leave an even count of people on both sides.

hints.title: Multiply Independent Side Combinations
hints.text: If person 1 connects with person i, the left partition has i - 2 people and right has numPeople - i people.

hints.title: Sum Catalan Products Modulo 10^9 + 7
hints.text: Accumulate the product of subproblem counts for left and right partitions for all valid choices of i.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all matching permutations leads to factorial branching and invalid crossings.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Catalan number recurrence computes non-crossing configurations in quadratic time and linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that non-crossing chords partition the circle into independent even subproblems.
